notes.title: Strawberry Interaction Bug Fix
notes.content:
Players were having issues interacting with the strawberry if they had reached the game over screen before getting to the strawberry.


Fixed the dialogue sequence. Player, even after dying, can now interact with the strawberry.

notes.title: Day 0 - Bug fixes
notes.content:
Few bugs that were missed during internal testing.

[/list]


Please report all future bugs to undothejamdamage@gmail.com
